description: Rust AI Agent Harness v1.4: LSP as first-class code intelligence (runtime auto-download with consent + SHA-256 + official-channel registry); symbol_search/symbol_references/outline REMOVED and merged into single lsp meta-tool ops with transparent tree-sitter (L0) fallback; OpenAI-compatible tools protocol; unified-allow tool surface (no per-tool approval, path-boundary-only safety) + pty(TTY)+terminal-emulator capture (progress bars render in place, model receives final-screen lines); Hashline edits[] batch patch; unified read handles file/dir/URL; bash background pid + await; todo auto-nudge; per-role models (agent/compact); MCP client via rmcp; TUI+Tauri+WebUI
changelog_vs_v1_6: V1.7 pty decision: command capture switched from non-TTY pipe + 5-step sanitizer to portable-pty (ConPTY on Windows) + in-process terminal emulator; programs see a TTY so tqdm/curl/pip/npm redraw progress in-place (single line); model-visible output = emulator screen final lines + exit_code; raw byte stream kept per-pid for UI replay; capture=raw escape hatch; pipe+CR-coalesce kept only as fallback when pty allocation fails; activity-timeout now driven by screen-change; stdout/stderr merge is inherent terminal semantics (redirect for split)
PRD condensed per user request: research narratives/tables removed, kept decisions+specs+registry+stories; decision log section 7 added; version chain compressed to one line
changelog_vs_v1_5: PERMISSION MODEL v1.6: all per-tool ask/approval REMOVED - every tool auto-allowed; sole gate = R4 path boundary. rename = dry-run preview default + apply=true immediate; MCP wildcards downgraded to optional deny blacklist (empty default); frontend diff cards non-blocking; LSP download consent KEPT (supply-chain gate, orthogonal to tool permissions); mitigations: git-rollback safety net + v2 cap-std sandbox eval

4.7.3 OUTPUT SANITIZATION PIPELINE (progress-bar flooding): risk confirmed - non-TTY still gets CR frames + ANSI from curl/wget/pip/rich (tqdm auto-throttles ~10s but frames persist); pipeline on delivery (buffer keeps raw for UI): CR segment+last-frame coalesce -> ANSI CSI/OSC strip -> similar-frame fold (>=3 normalized matches -> first+last+[xN]) -> truncation head2KB/tail8KB + sanitize_stats(raw/sanitized/coalesced); config output.sanitize on/off; pty mode v2; guardrail fixtures in US-017/018
changelog_vs_v1_4: windows shell misdirection fix (research-backed): command tool registered per-platform with EXCLUSIVE naming (POSIX=bash, Windows=powershell; pwsh.exe -> powershell.exe probing; bash only on Windows via explicit shell.prefer=git-bash) - no dual Bash+PowerShell co-registration (Claude Code choice rejected: doubles permission surface and wobbles model selection)

ShellSpec single-source-of-truth invariant: system prompt <env> section (OS/shell/version/<=8-line syntax cheatsheet) generated from same registry entry as tool description; CI unit test asserts equality (guards against Claude Code issue #51788 class regression where prompt said Shell: bash while PowerShell tool was registered)
bashism interception layer: pre-exec detection (&&, /dev/null, rm -rf, heredoc, $( ), forward-slash paths) -> return equivalent PowerShell syntax instead of executing a guaranteed-first-fail
readonly permission allowlist keyed per shell semantics (Get-ChildItem/Test-Path vs ls/cat/test); UTF-8 output encoding forced on powershell launch; CRLF-safe via hashline normalization

research sources: Claude Code dual-tool + env toggles; Codex experimental-windows + community AGENTS.md/pwsh7 PATH fix; Gemini CLI issues #2353/#3126/#18374; Cline issues #10444/#10446; OpenCode git-bash-vs-powershell thread; oh-my-pi embedded brush (v2 eval item)
changelog_vs_v1_3: REDUNDANCY AUDIT v1.4: symbol_search/symbol_references/outline tools deleted; capabilities = lsp ops workspace_symbols/references/document_symbols; L0 tree-sitter index becomes internal impl layer with transparent fallback (match:'name-based') instead of lsp_unavailable dead-end
glob kept with added optional path scope param; documented purpose: file-PATH pattern discovery (gitignore-aware, mtime sorted) complementing grep content search (Claude Code Glob parity)
PRD section 5 restored as FULL inline tool behavior catalog (11 entries, params/behavior/returns/perms), no cross-version references

mainstream naming alignment: bash background -> run_in_background; all timeouts ms (timeout_ms on bash/await/lsp); web_search count -> num_results; grep output_mode files -> files_with_matches; todo -> TodoWrite-style full-list replacement (omit items = list; merge=true incremental)

non-redundancy rulings recorded: grep(files_with_matches) vs glob different semantics keep both; lsp diagnostics op (query untouched files) vs auto post-edit injection complementary; no kill tool (system commands via bash); guard: if single lsp tool degrades weak-model call accuracy in eval, re-add 3 sugar wrappers sharing one impl
acceptance revised: US-005/010/014/017/018/019/020; risk table +2; total stories 27 unchanged
changelog_vs_v1_2: LSP promoted to L1 primary code-intelligence layer per user decision (compiler-accurate definition/references/hover/rename/diagnostics)
LSP client engineering spec: lsp-types 3.16 + self-built JSON-RPC state machine (ecosystem clients lsp-client/async-lsp-client/tokio-lsp are immature; tower-lsp is server-side)
LspSupervisor: on-demand didOpen, incremental didChange after edit/write, crash backoff restart <=3 then degrade, idle reclaim 10min, cancellation

Runtime auto-download (LSP Manager): built-in ServerRegistry; resolution order config override -> PATH -> local cache -> download; HTTPS + official-domain allowlist + mandatory SHA-256 + first-use consent; NON-interactive mode never auto-downloads (falls back to L0); rustedharness lsp list/install/update; offline manual install

Language server registry table with official channels for 24 mainstream languages (rust-analyzer, clangd, gopls, pyright, typescript-language-server, jdtls, kotlin-lsp/fwcd, csharp-ls, ruby-lsp, sourcekit-lsp, metals, lua-language-server, elixir-ls, haskell-language-server, bash/yaml/vscode-langservers npm family, + flagged-unverified: php/dart/zig/ocaml/R/fortran/dockerfile)
new lsp meta-tool (10 ops; rename -> WorkspaceEdit preview + ask); auto diagnostics injection after edit/write (2s cap)
SCIP route downgraded to v2 optional
new stories US-012..014; all stories renumbered, total 27; +5 risk rows (resource, supply chain, env fragmentation, server capability variance, diagnostics noise)

lsp: self-built JSON-RPC state machine on tokio stdio
candidates: lsp-client / async-lsp-client / tokio-lsp (all small, evaluate, expect custom client)
process: terminal emulator: vt100 / tui-emulator (or custom escape state machine)
